drifted.spec_text: On multi-turn traces, retain session-prefix blocks longer than LRU, reducing reloads by >=15% (design target). Prior spec text (2026-08-20) asserted no comparative harness exists and SC-001 is unverifiable.
drifted.actual: A comparative trace-replay harness DOES exist: apps/eviction-replay-benchmark replays a real multi-turn Qwen-Bailian trace through both eviction-policy-session-lists and eviction-policy-lru and reports per-policy hit-rate (miss == reload) at configurable cache sizes. It has existed since this component's introducing commit c247b890 (2026-08-04) and was missed by the 2026-08-07 and 2026-08-20 syncs, which inspected only benches/session_list_benchmark.rs. SC-001 is therefore measurable, not unverifiable; the sampled measured effect is real but workload/cache-size dependent and below the >=15% target (e.g. chat trace cache 256: session-lists 8.2% vs LRU 7.2%).
